READINESS PYRAMID
NOVEMBER 2026
THE JOURNEY FROM FAMILIARITY TO FLUENCY

AI Readiness
Pyramid Framework

Build familiarity and comfort with AI, then develop the literacy
and fluency to use it effectively and responsibly.

Fluency

Conceptual literacy: Understand how AI works.
“What & why?”

Operational literacy: Use AI in real workflows.
“How do I apply it?”

Governance literacy: Ethics and oversight.
“Should I? Is it responsible?”

Literacy

“I understand what it does.”

Learn AI language: prompts, models, bias, hallucination. Use AI effectively and responsibly.

From user to informed practitioner.

Comfort (Confidence)

“I’m not afraid of it.”

Interact without anxiety. Develop trust and safe practices. Psychological readiness.

AI becomes a tool, not a threat.

Familiarity (Exposure)

“I’ve seen it.”

Awareness that AI exists. Curiosity and recognition.
Fear starts to fade. Interest begins.
